mechanism_narrative: Continued recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals restoration of commuting and office routines, which lifts weekday retail footfall and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -38.4 to -13.1 over four weeks
fact:WORKPLACES rose from -41.7 to -19.7 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is not higher than last 28 days when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rose for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Crossing above -15 percent in TRANSIT marks the threshold at which mobility restrictions no longer bind retail trips, so RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -15 percent from baseline
failure_condition: When TRANSIT is above -15 percent, RETAIL_REC over next 28 days fails to exceed last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Declining RESIDENTIAL and elevated PARKS jointly indicate residents shifting from home to outdoor social activity, which spills over into retail-and-recreation trips and raises RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise when RESIDENTIAL declines and PARKS remains above 60.

mechanism_narrative: In the specific regime of reopening from Delta lockdown, WORKPLACES above -25 percent signals restored office occupancy that supports retail demand, so RETAIL_REC rises over four weeks.
failure_condition: In reopening regime, RETAIL_REC declines when WORKPLACES is above -25.

mechanism_narrative: Spring weather in Melbourne raises outdoor activity, as captured by high PARKS, and associated consumer optimism lifts retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise during September-October despite PARKS remaining above 60.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM remains above +10 percent, households are still in lockdown stockpiling mode and avoid discretionary retail, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stays above +10 percent for two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over next 28 days is higher than last 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM remains above +10.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES while RESIDENTIAL falls indicates a coordinated return to out-of-home routines that boosts retail-and-recreation mobility over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rose while RESIDENTIAL fell over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both increase while RESIDENTIAL falls.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS remaining above 65 percent indicates outdoor recreation substitutes for indoor retail, keeping RETAIL_REC below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises when PARKS stays above 65.
